caption: The drawing features a single clear glass teapot-like vessel with a handle, displayed in the center of a plain beige background. The vessel has a round, bulbous body with a twisted, spiral pattern along its surface, a spoutless form, and a domed lid with a small knob at the top. The object is rendered in shades of gray and light brown to suggest the transparency and reflective qualities of glass. The background has a slightly uneven texture with subtle brownish stains or marks, particularly toward the lower portion. The drawing includes the name "JOHN DANA" faintly visible in the bottom left corner, and the numbers "381" and "P. 13" in pencil in the bottom right corner.
title: Sparking Lamp
